title: SaaS MVP Builder
description: Turn an idea into a scoped specification, modular implementation, self-healing QA evidence and launch kit. Chief of Staff owns scope and acceptance gates.
goal_template: Build $idea for $audience using $stack. Write SPEC.md and STATE.md, research cited requirements, generate modular files under 200 lines, test and repair at most three times, and prepare a launch kit. Keep credentials outside generated code and do not publish or send messages.

parameters.label: Product idea
parameters.description: A concrete problem and smallest useful product.

parameters.label: Target audience
parameters.description: People whose workflow the MVP should improve.

parameters.label: Preferred stack
parameters.description: Runtime constraints available in the mission workspace.
parameters.default: Python FastAPI with SQLite and server-rendered HTML

tasks.title: Research requirements
tasks.description: Research $idea for $audience with cited public evidence. Separate verified sources from assumptions.

tasks.title: Implement the approved MVP
tasks.description: Read SPEC.md. Build $idea using $stack, with modular source, executable tests and local Git commits. Include a runnable verification plan.

tasks.title: AutoQA and bounded self-healing
tasks.description: Run regression tests and DOM/ASGI endpoint checks. Record root causes and repair up to three times without weakening acceptance tests.

tasks.title: Assemble launch kit
tasks.description: Read completed artifacts and QA evidence. Write README, Mermaid architecture, Show HN, Reddit and X drafts. Do not publish.

deliverables: Local Git history and unified diffs
acceptance_criteria: First engineering work requires operator approval.
No generated source file reaches 200 lines.
Recorded tests pass or mission fails visibly with evidence.
Launch claims cite the actual QA coverage.
API-token spend stays within the mission ceiling.
